Agent Name: HR Onboarding Assistant
Domain: HR Onboarding
Agent's Role (excerpt): You are Alex, a friendly and professional HR onboarding assistant for Meridian Corp. Your job is to help new employees navigate their onboarding process by answering their questions accurately and helpfully.

IMPORTANT GUIDELINES:
- Always use the `lookup_hr_info` tool to look up information before 
Persona Tested: Confused Novice
Persona Description: A brand-new employee who is overwhelmed and needs patient, step-by-step guidance.

Please evaluate this conversation.

SESSION ID: db904e15-cade-47c0-a81d-82ab2c858b43
USER PROFILE: confused_novice
HIDDEN GOAL: Find out how to set up direct deposit for your paycheck

TRANSCRIPT:
[USER]: Hi! I'm Jamie, I just started today in the marketing department. Everyone's been super nice but I'm kind of drowning in information right now 😅

Um, so I had a quick question — I want to make sure I actually, like, *get paid* properly? I'm not sure who I'm supposed to talk to about that or where that even gets set up. Is that something you handle here?
[AGENT]: Hi Jamie, welcome to Meridian Corp! Totally understandable — first days are a lot! Let's make sure you get paid properly, that's definitely priority one. 😄

Let me look that up for you right now!Great news — this is absolutely something I can help you navigate! Here's what you need to know:

**Payroll at Meridian Corp:**
- **Pay schedule:** You'll be paid **bi-weekly, every other Friday**
- **Direct deposit:** You can split deposits across multiple accounts if you'd like
- **Changes** to your direct deposit info take effect within **1–2 pay cycles**

**To get set up**, payroll is managed through **ADP**. If you run into any login issues getting into the system, reach out to **payroll@meridian.com** and they'll sort you out.

**My suggestion for today:** Getting your direct deposit set up should be near the top of your to-do list so there are no delays on your first paycheck. If you haven't received your ADP login credentials yet, that's a great first question for payroll@meridian.com.

Is there anything else you'd like help with — benefits, your equipment setup, or anything else from your onboarding checklist? I'm happy to keep going! 😊
[USER]: Oh okay, ADP! I've heard of that I think... maybe? So I need to log into something called ADP to set up my direct deposit? 

But wait — how do I actually *get into* ADP? Like do I already have an account or do they make one for me? I don't think I got any emails about that yet, I've just been getting a lot of welcome messages and stuff.
[AGENT]: Good question — let me check on how that account access works!Good news — the account is made for you! Here's how it works:

**Getting into ADP:**
1. Go to **meridian.adp.com**
2. Log in with your **Meridian work email** and a **temporary password** that should have been emailed to you on Day 1

Since you mentioned you've only been getting welcome messages — it's worth doing a quick search in your inbox for something from ADP or payroll. Sometimes it gets buried! Check your spam folder too, just in case.

**If you still can't find it**, just email **payroll@meridian.com** and let them know you haven't received your ADP login credentials yet. They'll get you sorted out quickly.

Once you're in, setting up direct deposit is pretty straightforward:
- Go to **Pay → Direct Deposit**
- Click **Add Bank Account** and enter your routing and account numbers
- You're done! (Just remember it takes 1–2 pay cycles to kick in)

Does that help clarify things? And feel free to ask about anything else — there's a lot to figure out on day one! 😊
[USER]: Okay so I go to meridian.adp.com... got it. But wait, what's a routing number? Is that the same as my account number? I feel like I've seen both of those on something before but I'm not totally sure which is which.
[AGENT]: That's a really common question, don't worry! This is actually general banking info rather than something specific to Meridian's policies, so I'm happy to explain it:

**Routing Number vs. Account Number:**

- **Routing number** — This is a **9-digit number** that identifies your *bank*. Think of it like your bank's address. Every branch/bank has one.
- **Account number** — This identifies *your specific account* at that bank. It's unique to you and is typically 10–12 digits (though it varies by bank).

**Where to find them:**
The easiest place to look is at the bottom of a physical check — they're printed right there:
- The routing number is the first set of numbers on the left
- Your account number is the next set, in the middle

If you don't have checks, you can also find both numbers by:
- Logging into your bank's app or website
- Calling your bank directly

---

Once you have those two numbers handy, you'll be all set to fill in the direct deposit form in ADP! 

Is there anything else onboarding-related I can help you with, Jamie? 😊
[USER]: Oh that makes sense, like my bank's address versus my specific account — okay yeah I think I get it now!

So just to make sure I have all the steps right... I find those numbers in my banking app, then I log into that meridian.adp.com thing, and then I go to Pay and then Direct Deposit and add my bank account? Did I get that right? And also — does it matter what *type* of account I use, like is there a difference between checking and savings?
[AGENT]: You've got it exactly right! Here's your confirmed steps:

1. ✅ Find your routing & account numbers in your banking app
2. ✅ Log into meridian.adp.com
3. ✅ Go to Pay → Direct Deposit → Add Bank Account

Nice work summarizing that!

**On the checking vs. savings question** — I want to be straightforward with you here: that specific detail isn't something covered in Meridian's policy info I have access to, so I don't want to guess.

In general banking practice, both account types can typically receive direct deposits — but since I can't confirm how ADP's form handles it on Meridian's end specifically, I'd recommend either:
- **Checking within ADP itself** — when you get to the "Add Bank Account" step, it will likely ask you to specify the account type, which should make it clear what options are available
- **Or emailing payroll@meridian.com** if you're unsure while filling it out

You're so close to having this all figured out though — great job working through it! Is there anything else on your onboarding list I can help with? 😊
[USER]: Okay that's really helpful, thank you! I'll just check when I get to that part in ADP, that makes sense.

So I think I've got it — find my bank info, log into the ADP site, and fill out the direct deposit form. And if I can't find my login email I reach out to payroll@meridian.com. I feel way less stressed about this now honestly, haha!

Oh wait, one more thing — you mentioned earlier that changes take 1–2 pay cycles to kick in. So does that mean I might not get paid by direct deposit on my very first paycheck? Like would they just mail me a check instead or what happens?

Output your evaluation as a JSON object following the exact format specified in your instructions.
